title: Steading Yard north blocked: both approach routes selected after one road
body:
Steading Yard blocks north with copy that **both approach routes are selected** after the player took only one road (sheltered stockway **or** Exposed Ridge).

This was the loudest grok-4.6 MCP-wave cluster: **63** `bugs[]` rows across 82 completed interviews (S1 52 / S2 11). Independent worst-moments named the same lie. Players can still finish Wolf-Winter; the text is wrong.

Fix: north-exit / blocked-reason copy must name the approach that is actually selected, or omit the “both routes” clause when only one launch road was taken.

Evidence: grok-4.6 instant-thinking wave, `ai-runs/playtest/sessions/`, 82 completed / 100 launched, build `fe2619a8`.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 MCP wave cluster (63 mentions, 82 completed interviews).
